content: Devin Desktop is an Agent Command Center with Spaces (group agents by project, shared context across sessions/PRs/files) and a Kanban view. Each session shows chat, plan, IDE, shell, and interactive browser live. Devin Review triages diffs into severity buckets (red=probable bug, yellow=warning, gray=FYI) grouped into logically related hunks with ordered explanations, plus an Auto-Fix suggestion you approve inline.
